findings.message: host port 8000/tcp is published twice by services "app" and "debug-ui": "8000:8000" at compose.yaml:4:13 and "8000:8080"
findings.suggestion: Only one mapping can bind a host port. Change one published port, bind them to different host IPs, or omit the host port to let Docker pick one.
Check the file name and location; env_file paths are resolved from the project directory (where the first Compose file lives). If the file is optional, use the long syntax with `required: false`.
